第1章(1)

有钱有权有势的好处很多，具体的展现为——在已客满、采预约制的俱乐部餐厅里，无须亮出代表身分的黑色美国运通卡，只需文景瑞那张辨识度极高的面容出现在餐厅门口，微笑询问服务人员一声，经理就会立刻出现，将他以及客户带往餐厅中最好的靠窗位置。

透过大片玻璃，能看见俱乐部外头一望无际的绿色草坪，远处连绵起伏的山峦在蓝天白云映衬下，有如世外桃源般令人向往。

“还是Vincent你有办法，传闻这家俱乐部餐厅一位难求，今天托了你这张脸的福，让我有幸一尝这里的美食，Ian上个月回到美国，对这里的樱桃鸭念念不忘呢！”年过四十的白人男子以英文期待又兴奋地说，眉眼间全是愉悦。

在喝了两杯餐厅招待的香槟后，他更是眉飞色舞地道：“Vesta太棒了，她很完美，我每个月都想见她……”

文景瑞听着眼前男人用着赞叹的口吻谈论着“她”，嘴角噙着浅浅笑意，静静聆听。

“对我一年飞六趟台湾，我太太十分不悦，昨天刚下机，一告诉她我在台湾，她就对着电话大吼Vesta毁了我们的婚姻。”提起这名惹恼太座的小三，白人男子无法压抑喜悦欢欣之情。“我太想见Vesta了。什么时候能让她跟我回迈阿密？我受够Ian炫耀他的Hemera！”提起死党，他脸上出现了嫉妒之色。

文景瑞忍不住笑出来，回以流利的英文道：“还有几项测试未通过，我们都希望她完美，若一切照着计划行事，我想，她可以跟你回去过今年的感恩节。”

“太好了，那是我跟我太太的结婚纪念日，我要在Vesta号上开感恩节派对！”男子神情充满兴奋。“我太太见了我为她在Vesta号上建的更衣间，肯定会收回Vesta毁了我们的婚姻这句话。”

“耐心等待，才能得到甜美的果实。”文景瑞笑了笑。

这名白人男子来到他的游艇公司，订购了一艘能够乘载二十人、船身长44.45公尺、宽8.52公尺的豪华游艇，是送给自己与妻子结婚二十周年的礼物，他为了妻子提出不少设计上的要求，更开心的说他非常期待女儿上大学之后不在家，只剩他们夫妻俩的日子。

“女人就是疑心病重，你懂的。”

白人男子完全聊开来，文景瑞也自然的与他交流，并未因为他是全球百大企业的集团负责人，而露出畏缩讨好的姿态。

拥有一间享誉国际的游艇公司，文景瑞接触的全是有权有势的客户，往往为了心爱的玩具一掷千金，眼睛也不眨一下。

一般来说，一艘游艇从设计、动工、组装到各种测试，大约要两年的时间才能完成，而游艇打造期间，那些下了单又日理万机的大老板们便心心念念着，多的是月月关心进度、还不时从世界的另一头飞来的人，就为了看一眼建造中的游艇，确定“她”一切安好，这才心满意足地重回工作冈位上。

向他订购游艇的客户们忙，文景瑞身为游艇集团老板兼设计师，更是忙碌不已，今日算是忙里偷闲，带着眼前这名下了大单的客户来俱乐部里吃个饭，尽尽地主之谊。

算起来，他也许久没有来到俱乐部，探视那匹日本不败三冠马Deep Impact的后代，不到两岁的“时光”。

“一个游艇公司老板却带客户来马场俱乐部吃饭，这真是有趣的现象。”吃着美味无比的樱桃鸭胸，白人男子突然想到什么，笑笑说道。

他怀疑很久了，他们所在的地方被群山环绕，拥有一片一望无际的草坪，跟能直接联想到大海的游艇完全不搭，而这位年轻又才华洋溢，在游艇同好间拥有无数好评的文景瑞却老是招待客户来这间离造船厂、海港有段不短的车程，完全看不见海景的俱乐部用餐。

文景瑞慢条斯理地咽下嘴里的牛肉丸，露出了一副“你懂的”的表情，这才开了口，“我在这里养了一匹马，近来忙着做水密测试，我已经有两周没见它了。”

游艇出船前都会进行水密测试，那是一个模拟在各种雨量之下，都能确保船艇不漏水的测试，通常水会从各种角度冲淋船身两到四个小时，由于这是最后的测试工作，不得马虎，因此文景瑞都会亲自在造船厂盯着。

白人男子露出了然的笑容。“我懂。”

有着各别爱好，但同样烧钱的两个男人，惺惺相惜地相视一笑。

饭局结束，文景瑞安排俱乐部派车送客户到机场，赶搭私人专机回美国，而他嘛，则打算去看一下那头花了他不少心力、金钱，才从日本运来台湾的爱马。

文景瑞在大门口送完客户，正要离开充满欧式古堡风格的主塔，便被俱乐部经理拦了下来。

“文先生，文老先生请您过去一趟。”西装笔挺的经理站姿端正，背打得很直。

眼前的男人是马场俱乐部中最年轻的会员，他的会员资格并不是靠着家族庇荫，而是靠着自己的能力，他所经营的波塞顿游艇集团，发源地在义大利一个临近地中海，名叫热那亚的城市，是游艇业市占率第一、最老字号的集团。

可惜这间知名游艇集团后继无人，让在波塞顿工作多年，一路爬进集团核心的文景瑞最后成为总裁，他拥有这偌大游艇王国的同时，也拥有了令人无法忽视的人脉，无论是全球各大企业的CEO、杜拜的王子，或是义大利黑手党、爱尔兰黑帮等等，都是文景瑞的客户。

台湾建造游艇的技术及市场越来越能与欧美大国匹敌，四年前，台湾一间游艇公司未撑过不景气的市场宣布倒闭，文景瑞评估后便买下那间造船厂，并留下了原本公司的资深员工，在台湾设立了波塞顿游艇集团的造船厂，自己则在台湾和义大利之间来回做空中飞人。

当他带领着波塞顿集团来到台湾时，可是引起了很大的回响，他带来的不只是一间造船厂，更让那些投资眼光独到的外商企业老板们在台湾停留，因而制造了许多投资机会，不只媒体对他感兴趣，台湾不少企业主都想接触这位人脉极广的游艇集团总裁。

没有企业大老板的架子，也从不摆出严肃到令人望而生畏的表情，文景瑞给人的印象便是个笑容和煦，亲切好相处的年轻人。

他的穿着也引领着潮流，米色西装外套内搭白色休闲衬衫，下身是黑色西装裤，一身简约却不失正式、时尚气息的穿衣风格，完全符合他的年纪—— 三十二岁，正可口的黄金单身汉。

俱乐部经理在这个销金窟中见识过各式各样的人，自然不会因文景瑞表现出来的和善、温和，就把他视为一个好相处的人，他看得出这个男人脸上虽然挂着笑容，笑意却不达眼底。

“文老先生竟想见我这个小辈？那我当然不能不给文老先生面子了，带路。”冰冷迅速闪过眼底，文景瑞浅浅一笑，让经理为他带路，也不多加为难。

经理并未因此松口气，反而如临大敌，领着文景瑞走过接待大厅，来到俱乐部的三楼。

在这间马场俱乐部里，会员都能拥有一个专属的房间，三楼的房间则是属于拥有会员资格长达三十年以上的人所有，而俱乐部的资深会员往往都是各个业界知名的人士。

Chapter 1(1)

There are many benefits of being rich and powerful. The specific manifestation is as follows - in a club restaurant that is fully booked and has a reservation system, there is no need to show the black American Express card that represents your identity. As long as Wen Jingrui's highly recognizable face appears at the door of the restaurant, he smiles and asks the waiter, and the manager will appear immediately and take him and the customer to the best window seat in the restaurant.

Through the large glass, you can see the endless green lawn outside the club. The rolling mountains in the distance are set against the blue sky and white clouds, making it as desirable as a paradise.

"Vincent, you still have a way. It is said that it is hard to find a seat in this club restaurant. Today, thanks to your face, I have the honor to taste the food here. Ian returned to the United States last month and has never forgotten the cherry duck here!" The white man over forty said expectantly and excitedly in English, with joy on his face.

After drinking two glasses of champagne served by the restaurant host, he was even more elated and said: "Vesta is great, she is perfect, I want to see her every month..."

Wen Jingrui listened to the man in front of him talking about "her" in an admiring tone, with a slight smile on his lips, and listened quietly.

"My wife is very unhappy that I fly to Taiwan six times a year. I just got off the plane yesterday, and as soon as I told her that I was in Taiwan, she yelled on the phone that Vesta has ruined our marriage." The white man could not suppress his joy when mentioning the mistress who had offended the queen."I want to see Vesta so much. When can I let her come back to Miami with me? I'm tired of Ian showing off his Hemera!" A look of jealousy appeared on his face when he mentioned his best friend.

Wen Jingrui couldn't help laughing and replied in fluent English: "There are still a few tests that have not passed. We all hope that she will be perfect. If everything goes according to plan, I think she can go back with you to celebrate Thanksgiving this year."

"Great, it's my wife's wedding anniversary, and I'm going to have a Thanksgiving party on the Vesta!" The man looked full of excitement."When my wife saw the dressing room I built for her on the Vesta, she would definitely take back her words that Vesta ruined our marriage."

"Wait patiently and you will get sweet fruits." Wen Jingrui smiled.

This white man came to his yacht company and ordered a luxury yacht that could carry 20 people, with a hull length of 44.45 meters and a width of 8.52 meters. It was a gift for himself and his wife for their 20th wedding anniversary. He made many design requirements for his wife. He even happily said that he was looking forward to the days when his daughter would not be at home after she went to college and they would be the only couple.

"Women are just suspicious and sick, you know."

The white man started chatting completely, and Wen Jingrui also communicated with him naturally, without showing any fear of trying to please him because he was the group leader of one of the world's top 100 companies.

Owning an internationally renowned yacht company, Wen Jingrui comes into contact with all powerful customers, and he often spends a lot of money on his favorite toys without blinking an eye.

Generally speaking, it takes about two years for a yacht to be completed from design, construction, assembly to various tests. During the construction of the yacht, the big bosses who place orders and have many things to do are thinking about it. Most of them are concerned about the progress every month and fly from the other side of the world from time to time just to take a look at the yacht under construction and make sure that everything is fine with "her" before returning to work with satisfaction.

The customers who ordered yachts from him were busy. As the owner and designer of a yacht group, Wen Jingrui was even more busy. Today, he took a break from his busy schedule and took the customer who placed a big order in front of him to have a meal in the club to show his loyalty as a landlord.

All in all, it may have been a long time since he came to the club to visit the offspring of Japan's undefeated Triple Crown horse Deep Impact, which was less than two years old.

"It's really interesting that a yacht company owner brings his clients to the racecourse club for dinner." While eating the extremely delicious cherry duck breast, something suddenly occurred to the white man and he said with a smile.

He had suspected for a long time that the place they were in was surrounded by mountains and had an endless lawn, which was completely incompatible with a yacht that could be directly associated with the sea. However, this young and talented Wen Jingrui, who had numerous praises among yacht enthusiasts, always invited customers to dine at this club, which was a short drive away from the shipyard and the harbor and had no view of the sea.

Wen Jingrui slowly swallowed the beef balls in his mouth, showed a "you know" expression, and then said, "I have a horse here. I have been busy doing watertight tests recently. I haven't seen it for two weeks."

Before the yacht leaves the ship, it will undergo a watertight test. It is a simulated test to ensure that the boat does not leak under various rainfall conditions. Usually water will wash the hull from various angles for two to four hours. Since this is the final test work, it must not be sloppy, so Wen Jingrui will personally watch it at the shipyard.

The white man smiled knowingly."I understand."

The two men, who had different hobbies but also spent money, looked at each other and smiled sympathetically.

After the dinner, Wen Jingrui arranged for the club to send a car to take the client to the airport to catch a private plane back to the United States. As for him, he planned to take a look at the beloved horse that had cost him a lot of effort and money to bring to Taiwan from Japan.

Wen Jingrui finished seeing off customers at the gate and was about to leave the main tower, which was full of European castle style, when he was stopped by the club manager.

"Mr. Wen, please come over, Mr. Wen." The manager in a straight suit stood upright with his back straight.

The man in front of him is the youngest member of the racecourse club. His membership does not rely on the protection of his family, but on his own ability. The Poseidon Yacht Group he runs has its origins in a city in Italy near the Mediterranean Sea called Genoa. It is the largest and oldest group in the yacht industry in terms of market share.

Unfortunately, there was no successor to this well-known yacht group, so Wen Jingrui, who had worked in Poseidon for many years and climbed into the core of the group, finally became the president. While he owned such a large yacht kingdom, he also had a network of contacts that could not be ignored. Whether they were CEOs of major global companies, princes of Dubai, Italian mafia, Irish gangsters, etc., they were all Wen Jingrui's clients.

Taiwan's technology and market for building yachts are increasingly rivaling those of European and American powers. Four years ago, a Taiwanese yacht company failed to survive the sluggish market and declared bankruptcy. After evaluation, Wen Jingrui bought the shipyard and retained the senior employees of the original company. He established the Poseidon Yacht Group's shipyard in Taiwan, and he traveled back and forth between Taiwan and Italy as a trapeze artist.

When he led the Poseidon Group to Taiwan, it caused a great response. He not only brought a shipyard, but also allowed foreign business owners with unique investment vision to stay in Taiwan, thus creating many investment opportunities. Not only the media was interested in him, but many business owners in Taiwan wanted to contact this well-connected president of the yacht group.

He doesn't have the airs of a corporate boss, and he never puts on a serious or intimidating expression. Wen Jingrui gives the impression of a young man with a warm smile, who is friendly and easy to get along with.

His clothes are also leading the trend. He wears a beige suit jacket with a white casual shirt and black suit pants. His dressing style is simple but formal and fashionable, which is completely consistent with his age - he is thirty-two years old, and he is a delicious golden bachelor.

The club manager has seen all kinds of people in this gold-selling cave, and naturally he will not regard Wen Jingrui as an easy person to get along with because of his kindness and gentleness. He can see that although there is a smile on this man's face, the smile does not reach his eyes.

"Mr. Wen actually wants to meet a junior like me? Then of course I have to give Mr. Wen face and lead the way." Coldness quickly flashed in his eyes, Wen Jingrui smiled lightly and asked the manager to lead the way for him without making any embarrassment.

The manager did not feel relieved. Instead, he led Wen Jingrui through the reception hall and to the third floor of the club as if facing a formidable enemy.

In this racecourse club, members can have an exclusive room. The rooms on the third floor belong to people who have been members for more than 30 years. The senior members of the club are often well-known people in various industries.
